key_claims.claim: AI applied to non-targeted first-trimester ultrasound sweeps estimates gestational age with a mean absolute error of approximately two days, matching expert crown-rump length measurement.
Ultrasound-derived radiomics features can differentiate high-grade from low-grade serous ovarian carcinoma in a pilot cohort.
GPT-5-Thinking assistance improves generalist radiologist accuracy in orbital and head-and-neck tumor MRI classification toward subspecialist levels.
Photon-counting CT shows staging performance comparable to MRI and superior to mammography for pretreatment breast cancer assessment.
Low paraspinal muscle attenuation on opportunistic chest CT independently predicts subsequent vertebral bone mineral density loss and fracture.
